chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn, from Ibn Muskān, from al-Ḥasan ibn Ziyād al-Ṣayqal, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: When a man performs salat sitting while he is able to stand, then let him make it double. And that which indicates that it is permissible for him to make it up as witr, even if he makes it up after al-ẓuhr.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to make up witr after al-ẓuhr, and what should someone do if he performed salat sitting while able to stand?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses a legal ruling concerning the qaḍāʾ of supererogatory salat and witr. It indicates that if a person prays sitting despite being able to stand, he should double it, and it also indicates the permissibility of making up the witr prayer even after al-ẓuhr.
